_comment: Supply spec for the ERC test structure (T1 item 11). ASAP7 layer numbers from design/a7s_common.py.
Gate role GATE 7/0 with active_layer ACTIVE 11/0 is required first by klt erc; no signal net is graded.

Power path: LISD (17/0) and LIG (16/0) -V0 (18/0)- M1 (19/0, rails, labels on 19/251) -V1 (21/0)- M2 (20/0, VSS strap). GATE-LIG is direct overlap, declared as a via on LIG's own layer so contacted gates are not reported floating.
n-well tie: ACTIVE inside WELL (1/0) under NSELECT (12/0) -> tap_requires NSELECT removes every PMOS source/drain.
substrate tie: region = extent minus WELL; ACTIVE under PSELECT (13/0) -> tap_requires PSELECT removes every NMOS source/drain.
